## Career focus

Jonathan works forward-deployed across service and client teams. He finds operational constraints, redesigns workflows and control models, contributes hands-on to governed AI and automation systems, drives adoption, and turns field learning into reusable products and standards.

His background spans field support, provisioning, service operations, Azure, Intune, Microsoft 365, multi-tenant automation, product strategy, service design, UX/UI/DX, and governed agents.

His automation practice began inside provisioning in 2023 after roughly 18 months learning and redesigning the manual operation. He accelerated that work on Immy.Bot while carrying concurrent Field Support Engineer, Provisioning Lead, and primary logistics-coordination responsibilities. AI Automation Engineer became his formal full-time role in 2025.

## Publicly presented outcomes

- 836.3 service-delivery hours returned in 2026 year to date. Forecast capacity from unreleased tools is excluded.
- Fresh-machine provisioning active work reduced from roughly 45 minutes to about two while human quality control remained.
- A 72-ticket provisioning backlog cleared within six months while the operating model was rebuilt.
- Automation hours increased 133% while billed labor remained essentially flat. This remains supporting evidence until the exact comparison window is published.

## Product portfolio

The portfolio includes service-delivery automation, portfolio and client-management tools, technical-research assistants, a multimodal enterprise assistant, an agentic application platform, agent and compute federation, and a DevOps teammate.

These have different maturity levels. They are substantial systems and capabilities, not one uniformly integrated product. People retain authority over writeback, merge, deployment, production changes, and spending.

## Open-source projects

- Cadre — a personal agent control plane: every agent gets a real computer of its own, and every action is decided by policy before it happens and recorded after. https://github.com/mejohnc-ft/cadre
- Shot Pill — visual-context delivery for agentic coding fleets over SSH. https://github.com/mejohnc-ft/pill-shot
- Rewst M365 Utilization Report — the public workflow behind the multi-tenant Microsoft 365 reporting evidence. https://github.com/mejohnc-ft/Rewst-M365-Utilization-Report
- NotMyRouter — a network evidence dashboard that proves whether the ISP or the router is the problem. https://github.com/mejohnc-ft/NotMyRouter
- TerminalBrain — Apple Notes, Drafts, and Obsidian exposed to agents over MCP. https://github.com/mejohnc-ft/TerminalBrain
